description: Edit, audit, and draft prose while suppressing common LLM writing habits and preserving the writer's existing voice.

defaultPrompt: De-AI this draft without flattening my voice.
Audit this passage for AI-writing patterns.
Rewrite this scene with grounded dialogue.
interface.longDescription: Edits, audits, and drafts prose using a concrete anti-slop workflow. It composes narrative in coherent units of thought and movement, prefers meaningful syntactic hierarchy, and runs structural and cadence gates before returning fiction. It also repairs authorial-management leakage, redundant demonstrations, procedural bookkeeping, semantic beat stacking, staccato cadence, unearned micro-interpretation, mechanical dialogue, canned significance, generic abstraction, templated rhetoric, and promotional puffery while preserving the writer's facts, voice, pacing, and genre.

name: human-prose-editor
